Example with multiple conditions:

AND IS PHONE_NUM EQUALS 10086
 OR IS PHONE_NUM EQUALS 10011
AND IS MSG_CONTENT CONTAIN arrears

Forward SMS messages from 10086 or 10011 whose content contains arrears. A leading space nests a condition under the preceding condition. Keep the English syntax unchanged. Complex rules can use more memory.

Example with multiple conditions:

AND IS PHONE_NUM EQUALS 10086
 OR IS PHONE_NUM EQUALS 10011
AND IS CALL_TYPE EQUALS 3

Forward missed calls from 10086 or 10011. A leading space nests a condition. Keep the English syntax unchanged.

Call types: 1 = Finished Incoming Call; 2 = Finished Outgoing Call; 3 = Missed Call; 4 = Incoming Call; 5 = Answered Incoming Call; 6 = Started Outgoing Call.

Example with multiple conditions:

AND IS PACKAGE_NAME EQUALS com.example.app
 OR IS PACKAGE_NAME EQUALS com.example.other
AND IS INFORM_CONTENT CONTAIN arrears

Forward notifications from either example package whose content contains arrears. Replace the example package names with the apps you want to match. A leading space nests a condition. Keep the English syntax unchanged.
